description.value: Seasons Farm Market is a barn-based farm market in Abbotsford's agricultural corridor, stocking local free-range eggs, fresh dairy, garden produce, baked goods, and quality cuts of meat. The market emphasizes ethically raised, sustainable, and locally sourced food, and positions itself as a community gathering spot as much as a grocery stop. For a touring cyclist passing through the Fraser Valley farmland, it offers a genuine farm-fresh resupply point.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: bollard (2 spaces) at 19m. Total: 2 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is available and corroborates all OSM contact details (phone, address, website). The site describes a full-service farm market selling produce, eggs, dairy, baked goods, and meat, confirming Basic groceries. No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or any other cycling-specific amenities anywhere on the site, so those remain null. The copyright year '© 2026' and active website confirm the business is currently open.
concerns: OSM records old_name 'Nature\'s Pickin\'s Market', indicating the business was recently rebranded or the location changed hands; website describes itself as 'the new market in town', consistent with this transition.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-stocked local farm market with confirmed fresh groceries in Abbotsford's cycling region; a useful resupply stop for touring cyclists in the Fraser Valley.
enrichment_extras.notes: Website email info@seasonsfarmmarket.ca is not in the OSM record and could be added.
